name: planetscale-postgres-serverless
description: Connecting to PlanetScale Postgres from serverless and edge runtimes with the Neon serverless driver (@neondatabase/serverless) — HTTP and WebSocket modes, the required neonConfig (fetchEndpoint, wsProxy, pipelineConnect), connection strings, transaction support, framework setup (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, Deno, Netlify), ORM integration, and when to use pg + PSBouncer instead.
